items.title: Vercel Connect now supports Secure Compute
items.snippet: Vercel Connect now supports Secure Compute , allowing connectors to reach providers with IP allowlists, such as Salesforce and Snowflake. With Secure Compute routing enabled, Connect’s provider requests use the selected network’s dedicated static IP addresses instead of Connect’s shared IPs. items.title: Unblock agentic software delivery with governed code review
items.snippet: AI agents have changed how much code a team can produce in a day. Review queues haven’t kept up, and delivery stalls while changes wait for a closer look. The usual workarounds (reminders, reviewer rotations, assigning a team) buy a little time and then burn people out.
